profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Tandem Diabetes Care
profile.summary:
Electrical Engineer with a focus on embedded systems development. Skilled with hardware design and firmware architecture design and development. Experienced with a variety of protocols and standards. Knowledgeable of compliance standards for electronics safety in medical devices.

Hardware Layout/CAD: EagleCAD, Altium Designer

Microcontrollers: PIC (dsPIC, PIC18F, PIC12F, PIC16F), ARM Cortex-M4 (STM32F4)

Protocols: I2C, UART, SPI, Modbus, BTLE, CAN

Hardware Miscellaneous: Surface Mount and Through Hole Soldering, Reflow, Chassis design, AC/DC/Stepper motor control

Software Languages: C, C++, Python, C#, Assembly, Java, Perl, PHP, LabVIEW

Operating Systems: Linux, Unix, Mac OSX, Windows, FreeRTOS

Miscellaneous: MySQL, REST

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Core team member coordinating Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, and Engineering Test activities on insulin injection pen cap project
Drove security analysis efforts for Bluetooth Low Energy interfaces for safety and business risk reduction
Technical lead for partner device integration in automated insulin delivery and insulin injection pen cap embedded systems
Architected and led development using Python on crucial embedded test modules intended for use in Verification and Validation activities
Operated as SCRUM Master and eventually as the current Product Owner for an independent firmware team
Developed and maintained a scalable automated test network using VMWare and Jenkins reducing node deployment time by 60%
Facilitated efforts on system level error mapping for connected devices to align product, clinical, regulatory, test, and engineering functions on consistent and accurate error handling
Created and continuously maintain requirements, architecture, design, engineering report, test protocol, test report, risk, and traceability documents for insulin inject pen cap, automated insulin delivery, and embedded test modules

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Utilized C, C#, Python, Javascript
• Technical lead for small engineering team on a wide array of projects with a focus on 2nd Generation device development
• Supported 1st Generation devices through fabrication and troubleshooting
• Designed and developed 2nd Generation hardware achieving 90% reduction in power usage and 80% reduction in material costs
• Architected and developed firmware for 2nd Generation device using FreeRTOS and utilizing SPI, UART, I2C, and CAN interfaces
• Assisted in implementing Quality System and related documentation for a successful 510(k) FDA submission
• Designed and prototyped circuit boards for use in research studies
• Worked with research teams to implement innovative control strategies
• Managed manufacturing of small batch circuit boards
• Played integral role for reviews of product and system requirements compliant to IEC 60601-1, ISO 14971, MDD 93/42/EEC, IEC 62304-1 and CFR Title 21.
• Develop and review system specifications, architecture, verification and validation documentation. Compose FMEAs and root-cause analysis for several projects.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for PCB design and layout. Also responsible for development of firmware and additional support software for embedded wireless device and for production level devices. Utilized C through Microchip's XC compilers for the PIC24F and PIC32MX series microcontrollers. Created an automated test framework in Python with a scalable design. Built a continuous integration server using BuildBot on a DigitalOcean server. Participated in ensuring device passed FCC testing requirements.

positions.title: Engineer II
positions.description:
Design and development of automated distributed test platform requiring the use of Linux and Windows machines. Development consisted of web UI and engine written in C#, .NET, ASP.NET, Knockout.js, and using a MongoDB database. Linux devices used C/C++ drivers for different functions and communicated using JSON RPC.

Additional responsibilities included supporting previous projects.

positions.title: Engineer I
positions.description: Responsible for the design and prototyping of hardware used for testing. Created a LED light analyzer coupled with an amplifier design that boosted the signal for better sensitivity through an A/D converter. Played an integral role developing architecture designs for a satellite simulator. Created an application to gather data on testing results and reduced time spent gathering the data by 90%. Utilized Agile methodologies to develop software to interconnect systems automating 99% of the process.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Primarily work on designing, prototyping, and documenting hardware used for automation purposes. Utilized PIC and Atmel microcontrollers to provide solutions using serial and I2C protocols.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graded homework and tests while aiding in organizing grades. Held office hours for help outside of class.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on three projects. First was to help implement a temperature control system with a PID controller. Second was to implement the hardware and the software architecture for the automation of a test platform. Third was to create a femtoampere current amplifier. Other responsibilities were to create prototypes and test different systems.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked to create a new type of packaging system utilizing different systems to work together to efficiently accomplish objectives. Worked in a C environment with large exposure to hardware, both electrical and mechanical.

volunteerExperiences.description: Inspected robots during the Colorado competition. Ensured robots met regulations and advised teams on meeting regulations in the presence of a violation.
